verdict.summary: The change correctly separates candidate admission (`is_staged`) from fence reach (`on_frontier`) and limits the new one-way EC2 hold to the two dispatcher-selected statuses. It remains fail-closed when the label is unavailable, preserves live-claim and non-dispatch status exclusions, and relies on the existing snapshot fingerprint check to avoid racing a concurrent claim. The shared fence helper keeps both paths consistent. The added self-tests are non-vacuous: they cover ready/deferred positives, code-only/in-progress/inventory/already-gated negatives, add-only mutation shape, unavailable-label failure, and readiness-engine exclusion.
